objective: Test a recursively updated network model under the original signal executor and PP feedback; source information can later serve as a local-dynamics prior, while target data calibrate target conditions.

state.S_s: Tuple(P_s,E_s,B_s,Z_s): model state just before possible control requests at integer second s.
state.P_s: One mass-one packet per active vehicle: lane, exact front position, speed, acceleration/lateral state, parameter profile, causal body trail and persistent latent intended movement. Internal-lane packets remain explicit.
state.E_s: All-TLS complete signal strings, current/target green identities, mode, green age, remaining and pending-allred clocks; static timings and clearance sets remain attached.
state.B_s: Boundary due/pending/inserted inventory and causal arrival/turning beliefs. Unobserved entry allocation is uncertain state, not zero demand.
state.Z_s: Last-step lane N/H/nativeO/speed registers used by the unchanged policy and physical cost.
state.G: Static lane/link geometry and directed conflict/receiving graph, including ordered internal paths.
state.claim: A closed state for a declared approximate model. Driver memory, intent and road sensing remain approximations, not an exact SUMO Markov-state claim.

one_second_transition.meaning: At a decision epoch, apply all requests once with the original feasible-state/min-green/clearance rules. At other seconds A_s is empty.
Complete per-link applied signals for the following one-second movement interval.

Local physical transition kernel moves conserved packets, handles legal lane/link transfers and receiving supply, and processes due demand through pending queues. W_s contains model-generated exogenous outcomes, not measured future events.
Reconstruct front-assigned lane vehicle and halted counts, native occupancy using body portions and matching speed registers from predicted evolution.
Use the same executor update order as the native producer: after movement, poll predicted clearance-lane vehicle counts and advance clocks.
After ten inner steps, calculate the next PP request from this predicted state. There is no true-state reset.

policy.lane_score: q_l = H_l +0.35*N_l +0.025*O_l, with native fraction O on the fixed runtime.
policy.PP: Maximize sum(q_l) over the original deduplicated incoming lanes with any G/g-permitted link, constrained by the executor. Preserve original canonical tie order.
policy.dynamics_signal_semantics: A packet transition distinguishes exact connections, G/g priority, foes, yields and receiving supply; this does not replace the original PP scoring rule.
policy.cost_counts: H_l counts packets with speed<0.1m/s using the lane getter membership convention; body overlap affects occupancy, not duplicate packet mass.
policy.clearance_counts: Match the original lane vehicle-number getter on the specified clearance lanes; do not redefine clearance as any body overlap if the native getter would not count it.

model_components.shared_local_dynamics: A graph/local-parent transition kernel for longitudinal motion, stop/start, lane changes, junction passage and receiving constraints. Source and target use physical units and identical parent semantics.
model_components.deterministic_structure: Mass accounting, static connection legality, packet identity, actuator state machine, policy and cost integration are explicit operators.
model_components.target_only_beliefs: Boundary arrival process, fleet distribution for unseen entrants and turning beliefs are estimated from causal target observations. S/T/P later share these beliefs and the target data.
model_components.source_prior: Source may regularize transferable local motion/passage parameters. It does not supply a source450 cost head or a future target traffic schedule.
model_components.fitting_family: Statistical kernel family, complexity, source-placebo construction and training budget require a later protocol after measurement admission; none is fitted in this design step.
model_components.scaling: Use declared physical-unit normalizations in any later model. No automatic promotion of tiny empirical feature RMS into large decision weights; numerical scaling must be frozen and reviewed with the model protocol.

single_intervention_planning.Q_PP: For each legal focal request a, average C450 across model-generated future scenarios: C450=sum over seconds1..450 of controlled-lane halted packets divided by(450*controlled_lane_count). Other TLS use PP at the initial epoch, and every TLS uses its own predicted-state PP thereafter.
single_intervention_planning.comparison: Within each scenario use the same initial observed state and exogenous demand/latent-intent draws across all candidates. Retain blocked external packets rather than changing due demand with the action.
single_intervention_planning.scenarios: Scenario number and the causal boundary/intent model must be frozen with the later planning protocol. No actual future departure schedule, actual future PP request or future packet state is supplied.
single_intervention_planning.first_action: Compare candidate-minus-predicted-PP cost; score ties prefer the actual initial PP request then canonical order. No post-hoc threshold search is proposed.

policy_scope_limit.current: Only the first focal request followed by450-second own-state PP continuation is specified. Closed-loop here means predicted traffic interacting with predicted PP/executor feedback.
policy_scope_limit.not_established: A learned controller selecting new model actions every10seconds is a different policy; no benefit or policy-consistent label claim transfers automatically.
policy_scope_limit.future_full_hour: Before a new one-hour panel, specify control scope, decision cadence and continuation. Nonoverlapping450-second options preserve each option continuation;10-second receding model control needs its own policy-improvement hypothesis and independent evaluation. Neither is selected in this design.

existing_assets.reuse: Frozen repaired Jinan network, original423dc producer, SUMO1.22, SafePhaseExecutor, native-prefix semantics, static lane/link and conflict readers, population ledgers and prior sparse measurements.
existing_assets.cannot_reuse_as_new_training: Old20 target states, the closed reader recipe and the proposed eight-branch measurement pilot are not new independent training/evaluation evidence.
existing_assets.new_implementation_before_measurement: Passive prefix/body-trail recorder; dense all-network per-second packet/lane/flow logging; native PP/executor replay and sensor/cost ledger admission. No learned kernel or planner is required to run that measurement pilot.

next_stage: Eight-start measurement-only proposal, specified in measurement_protocol_proposed.json. It has not run.

references.use: Motivates testing model usefulness for value/planning; does not establish this proposed architecture.
Native1.22 lane getters and occupancy forwarding.
